Human Safety Foundation (HSF) is a non-governmental organization established in Bangladesh and duly registered with the Bangladesh Government since 2009. Committed to serving the marginalized communities in rural Bangladesh, our organization operates under the guiding principle of "Always We Are…"

What we want to do:
In underserved rural areas, individuals often lack access to proper medical care from qualified professionals, leading them to rely on pharmacies and unlicensed practitioners. This gap in primary healthcare access results in unchecked medication usage and dependence on unregulated treatments. Recognizing this pressing issue, HSF endeavors to launch the Access to Primary Health Care (A2PHC) project in rural and remote regions.

Project Overview:
This A2PHC initiative aims to address the healthcare discrepancy by providing essential medical advice in 10 unions of Dhunat and Sariakandi Upazila in Bogura District, 10 unions of Baniachang and Nabiganj Upazila in Habiganj District. Each day, our designated and registered physician will cover two unions, ensuring comprehensive healthcare access to the local community.

Objectives of the Project:
•	Delivering comprehensive medical consultations and prescriptions
•	Facilitating access to primary healthcare services
•	Mitigating reliance on unlicensed practitioners
•	Discouraging self-medication practices

job_description: WARBE Development Foundation:  WARBE Development Foundation is a non-profit organization working in the field of migration and development in Bangladesh since 1997. WARBE took the pioneering role in Bangladesh as a migrant workers’ association to deal with the issues of migrants’ rights. WARBE has undertaken many development activities at the grassroots and national and international levels to protect the rights, well-being and dignity of migrant workers and their families. As part of this, WARBE DF with support from the Winrock International is implementing the Ashshash (Phase–II) in Dhaka East and Narsingdi which is funded by the Embassy of Switzerland in Bangladesh. PROJECT BACKGROUND: Winrock International – Ashshash (Phase–II), is funded by the Embassy of Switzerland in Bangladesh. The project is supporting human trafficking survivors with sustainable social and economic reintegration into their respective communities, and also providing support-services that ensures their wellbeing and self-sufficiency. The survivors are getting psychosocial counseling support along with other social services, and facilitated opportunities for skills-devolvement and entrepreneurship training. Through which, the economic empowerment of the survivors is also ensured in the forms of wage-based and self-employment, and other income generation opportunities. The main objective of the project is to ensure that “women and men who have escaped trafficking will restore their dignity and wellbeing, and become self-sufficient”. Furthermore, Ashshash will reach people in the project’s working areas; either directly or indirectly, through awareness-raising activities on factors that make people vulnerable to human trafficking, and to ensure the prevention of human trafficking. The Ashshash project is providing comprehensive and personalized packages of service-provision to the survivors of human trafficking in Bangladesh. The project is implemented in ten of the most trafficking-prone areas across the country. POSITION SUMMARY: Project Manager (PM) will work under the direct oversight of WARBE (Ashshash’s Sustainable Reintegration Partner (SRP) across the working districts of Dhaka East & Narsingdi of the project. The PM will work as lead of the Ashshash project at WARBE DF. job_description: Transparency International Bangladesh (TIB) is inviting applications from Bangladeshi nationals for the position of Research Associate (RA) to be recruited for a project titled  Strengthening Banking Sector Integrity in Bangladesh (BSI).  The Research Associate (BSI) is expected to join in August-September 2026 and serve until June 2027, renewable subject to extension of the project and mutual agreement. The incumbent will be based in Dhaka, subject to field work anywhere in Bangladesh.  Project objective in brief:  The project aims to address major governance weaknesses in the banking sector, including weak regulatory enforcement and oversight, anti-money-laundering regime, and recovery of non-performing loans. These challenges contribute to illicit financial flows and weakened public trust in the banking sector of Bangladesh. The project combines research and evidence-based policy advocacy to assess integrity risks in regulatory compliance, prevention of illicit financial flows, and loan recovery. The project will evaluate integrity in the banking sector based on targeted research indicators, legal review, key informant/in-depth interviews, data analysis, and stakeholder consultations. Based on the findings, the project will engage regulators, policymakers, financial institutions, civil society, academics, researchers, and the media to promote transparency, accountability, and stronger regulatory independence in the banking sector of Bangladesh.   Responsibilities Reportable to the Coordinator-BSI, the Research Associate-BSI will be responsible for: Contributing in development of research strategies, conceptual frameworks, and analytical dimensions focusing on regulatory compliance, anti-money laundering (AML), illicit financial flows, institutional oversight, conflict-of-interest practices, loan recovery mechanisms, and asset quality. Supporting development of research methods, analytical dimensions, and data collection strategies for project implementation. Conducting literature review, policy review, legal and regulatory analysis, and background research on banking sector integrity with special reference to banking sector of Bangladesh and international standard and regulatory compliance. Assisting analytical assessment of non-performing loans (NPLs), regulatory forbearance, supervisory effectiveness, institutional capacity, enforcement gaps, and political economy dynamics within the banking sector. Contributing to the development of banking sector integrity indicators, institutional assessment frameworks, and evidence-based analytical outputs. Supporting development and pre-testing research instruments/tools, interview guides, questionnaires, and other data collection tools while ensuring methodological quality and consistency. Conducting Key Informant Interviews (KIIs), In-depth Interviews (IDIs), Focus Group Discussion (FGD), and stakeholder consultations. Coordinating and monitoring field research activities, ensuring adherence to research protocols, ethical standards, and quality assurance procedures. Preparing clean dataset and/or transcripts and analyse qualitative and quantitative data using appropriate analytical methods and software. Contributing in preparation of high-quality research reports, policy briefs, and banking integrity risk assessment frameworks that are evidence-based, analytically rigorous, policy-relevant, and actionable at the national level. Providing technical support and policy inputs for stakeholder engagement through consultations, policy dialogues, roundtables, dissemination workshops, and advocacy initiatives. Undertaking field visits within and outside Dhaka for data collection, monitoring, stakeholder engagement, and other project-related activities as required. Performing any other responsibilities assigned by the authority in line with the project objectives and organisational priorities.

job_description: Job Summary:  The Associate Officer - Sports for Protection will be responsible for implementing Sports for Protection, Social Cohesion, and Inclusion activities in Rohingya refugee camps in Ukhia and Teknaf, Cox`s Bazar. This role will involve building capacity and supervising volunteers, organizing work plans, and mobilizing communities to strengthen inclusivity, protection, and social cohesion. The Associate officer will facilitate various sports-based activities and ensure adherence to rules, regulations, and codes of conduct.  Project Name	:  Sustainable Solution and protection for the Rohingya Refugee Community in Camps (Supported by UNHCR) Types of contract:  Fixed-term contract up to 31 December 2026 (if not extended). Key responsibilities include (not limited to): Facilitation of Sports for Protection, Social Cohesion, and Inclusion Activities Identification of sports field in consultation with community, present users, UNHCR and camp authority and assist in activities for preparing field for sports.    Keep the sports field usable for regular sports with community. Prepare sports field day wise use plan in a community led approach.  Mobilize community in care & maintenance of sports field with support from volunteers.          Identify sports club members, participants for training and workshop, training venue, and facilitate sports club formation and keep functioning.   Mobilize for sports club operational manual through a participatory process.   Mobilize community, prioritize community proposed sports and identify the sports community prefer.   Organize and supervise sports events, tournaments, and competitions. Arrange sports events inside the camp, inter-camp sports competition, and ‘sports for peace- mega refugee football event’.  Dissemination of Sports for Protection message during Day Observance.       Support for sports for protection stakeholders meeting and prepare implementation strategy   Develop and implement sports-based activities to promote inclusivity, protection, and social cohesion among refugees and host communities.  Establish/maintain/update database of sports club members, and volunteers (formation process, date of formation, profiles, training attendance) in the respective location of responsibility.  Provide regular feedback to AAB on the status of the club members, volunteers and relevant changes in the compositions in the camp.  Facilitate training sessions on sports skills, rules, regulations, and codes of conduct for volunteers and participants.  Monitor and evaluate the impact of sports activities on participants` well-being, social cohesion, and protection.  Coordinate with relevant stakeholders, including UNHCR and other partners.      Administrative Support Work with the Coordinators to make plans for the material and logistical needs of the program.  Initiate sports and store items procurement requisitions, receive, and preserve in stores.  Supervise, monitor providing frontline support to volunteers in relation to the distribution of material (for instance, forms, vests, stationery), administrative (i.e. issuance of ID card, attendance record keep and filing, payment of support cost, approval of sick/business leave) task.  Ensure admin support for logistical needs (arrange training venue, lunches, breaks, and other amenities) to enable volunteers to perform their work efficiently.        Supervision of Volunteers, Organization of Work Plans, and Mobilization Activities Recruit, train, and supervise volunteers to support sports activities, including sports field and stores.  Develop and implement work plans for sports programs at the camp level.  Mobilize refugees and host community members to participate in sports activities.  Coordinate with community leaders and organizations to ensure effective outreach and engagement.      Coordination with Sports Clubs, Existing Youth Clubs, and Stakeholders Establish and maintain coordination with formed sports club, existing local sports clubs, youth clubs, and other relevant stakeholders.  Keeping linkage and cooperation with camp actors to leverage resources and expertise for sports programs.  Represent ActionAid Bangladesh in relevant Block meetings and forums.  Reporting and documentation Maintain accurate records of participant attendance, training sessions, and event outcomes.  Facilitate sports club formation and meeting records.      Collect data, prepare and submit weekly, monthly, half-yearly, and annual reports on project activities, progress, and challenges.  Work with the volunteers, to provide daily updates, review past week’s work/activities.  Lead a debriefing session for experience sharing and learning among the volunteers.  Maintain communication with community and the volunteers on a regular basis to understand the problems, challenges they face in their work, and together with the team, identify and implement creative solutions.  Identify good practices, promote and recognize outstanding work performance or contribution from volunteer team members.  Set up and maintain database, filing, documentation, and record systems to support all the above-mentioned works  Relationships:  The incumbent will report to the Coordinator – Sports for Protection

job_description: Introduction to VSO:  VSO is the world`s leading international non-governmental organisation that works through volunteers to create a fair world for everyone. Our work centres on those who are left out by society - those living in extreme poverty or with disability and illness. Those who face discrimination and violence because of their gender, sexuality, or social status. Those who are at risk from disaster, disease, and conflict. But they are not passive beneficiaries of aid; they are the "primary actors" at the heart of our efforts. From their perspective, we define the issues, opportunities, and solutions that drive sustainable, local-led change. These individuals are the key agents of their own transformation. Our Approach:  Our Volunteering for Development (VfD) method supports the most vulnerable and marginalised to achieve their rights and bring about lasting change to create a fair world for everyone. Rooted in addressing the fundamental causes of - marginalisation and vulnerability, our three core approaches - social inclusion and gender, social accountability, and resilience - guide our work in inclusive education, health, and resilient livelihoods. Our Volunteering for Development method recognises the importance of relationships in forging a shared understanding and commitment and building collective action to lasting change. With most of our volunteers being national, we build blended teams of community, national, and international volunteers, uniting diverse perspectives, and experiences to generate insight, innovation, and action that tackles the complex issues faced by our communities. This kindles the potential for active citizenship worldwide, encouraging people to step forward and lead the change that fosters a fair world for all. Project background and contextual information The ACTIVE Extension Project is part of a multi-country initiative across Asia and Africa that strengthens civil society groups (CSGs) through volunteering for development (VfD) while enhancing the capability and accountability of public systems. In Bangladesh, ACTIVE accompanies youth and community led (e.g. Farmers association) platforms/networks across all 64 districts. The goal is to lead their own development pathways, engage in civic and policy spaces, co-create inclusive, resilient and accountable services. Through practical, community-led interventions in SRHR, climate resilience and DRR, livelihoods and system strengthening, CSGs apply participatory practices to foster inclusion, build resilience, mobilise resources and sustain development gains. The specific goal is to support CSGs for building confidence, facilitating peer learning and connecting groups to tools, networks and other stakeholders so that, communities can organise, collaborate, and advocate at their own pace. By scaling models like the National Youth Forum and MILE and creating synergies with other VSO initiatives, ACTIVE project advances locally led change and system accountability to community priorities. Coordinate and support organisational capacity development strategies, including assessments and action plans aligned with localisation priorities. Design and facilitate inclusive capacity development initiatives, empowering Rohingya communities—especially women, adolescents, persons with disabilities, and other vulnerable groups—to participate in WASH service delivery. Coordinate planning, implementation, monitoring, and reporting of capacity development activities with relevant teams and technical units. Monitor and evaluate capacity development interventions to improve programme quality and organisational performance. job_description: Background Friends In Village Development Bangladesh (FIVDB) is a Bangladeshi non-governmental organisation founded in 1979 under the Societies` Registration Act, 1860. The organisation is also registered with the NGO Affairs Bureau and the Micro Credit Regulatory Authority, of the Government of Bangladesh. The organisation`s societal vision is that of `a vibrant society based on justice, equity, democracy and environmentally sound principles`. It works with the mission to give the disadvantaged women, men and children greater voice, reduce their vulnerability, increase their use of citizenship rights and help them enhance their quality of life. FIVDB is implementing the `Recovery and Advancement of Informal Sector Employment (RAISE)` Project under the Additional Financing phase, implemented by the Palli Karma-Sahayak Foundation (PKSF) with support from the World Bank, aims to enhance employment opportunities, entrepreneurship development, and economic inclusion for low-income youth and microentrepreneurs. The project aims to enhance employment and income-generating opportunities for low-income youth through skills development, apprenticeship programs, entrepreneurship promotion, access to finance, and other livelihood support interventions. The project places particular emphasis on women, disadvantaged groups, and climate-vulnerable communities, thereby fostering inclusive economic growth and sustainable livelihoods across Bangladesh. The RAISE Project is being implemented nationwide through selected Partner Organizations (POs) of PKSF. As a Partner Organization of PKSF, FIVDB is responsible for implementing the project within its designated operational area in accordance with the project objectives and implementation guidelines. The duration of the Project is 4 years (up to June 2030). To ensure effective implementation of the project and achievement of its intended outcomes, FIVDB invites applications from qualified, experienced, and motivated professionals for  Training and Employment Support Officer (TESO)  position under the RAISE Project. The detailed Terms of Reference (ToR) for the position are provided below. Key Responsibilities a) Training facilitation and capacity building Prepare a comprehensive training plan and conduct Life Skills, Business Management and Entrepreneurship Development (BMED), and Risk Management and Business Continuity (RMBC) training sessions in accordance with approved curricula, training manuals, and project guidelines. Prepare and deliver training sessions by developing session plans, training materials, presentations, handouts, and practical exercises, while facilitating interactive learning through participatory methods such as group discussions, case studies, role plays, simulations, and practical demonstrations to achieve effective learning outcomes. Ensure an inclusive, participatory, and learner-centered training environment that promotes active engagement and equal participation. Identify training gaps and recommend improvements to training content, methodologies, and delivery approaches. Prepare and submit training completion reports, participant performance summaries, and other required documentation in a timely manner. b) Career Preparation and Counseling Provide individual and group counseling during and after training. Help apprentices set career goals and plan accordingly. Conduct sessions on CV writing, interview preparation, workplace behavior, etc. Coordinate Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) certification where applicable. c) Employment and Entrepreneurship Support Implement training and capacity-building activities to strengthen project participants` business management, risk management, and business continuity competencies. Match graduates with job or self-employment opportunities. Guide apprentices on business startup and link them with financial and support services. Guide apprentices and Young Micro-entrepreneurs (YME) in developing business plans, financial literacy, and basic business management skills. d) Employer, Industry and Stakeholder Engagement Build partnerships and work intensively with MCPs, POs, local government, local employers and industries to create a supportive employment ecosystem for the apprentices. Formation and Functionalization of Employment Cells at the Field Level. Organize recruitment events, job fairs, and on-site interviews. e) Placement Tracking and Monitoring Keep records ofjob placements and follow up on job status and satisfaction. Maintain an updated database and track career progress of Apprentices, Young Micro-entrepreneurs. f) Reporting and Documentation Maintain project records, prepare regular progress reports, database and document success stories. Additional Responsibilities Support Community Outreach and Mobilization, especially for marginalized groups (e.g.Women, PwDs, ethnic minorities). Oversee enrollment, motivation, and mentoring of apprentices. Facilitate and access to entrepreneurship training, financing, and wider job markets. Promote gender equality, inclusion, and safeguarding in all activities. Support research and data collection like tracer studies and labor market assessments. Any other project-related responsibilities assigned by the management as required. Qualified women are strongly encouraged to apply.

সংস্থার ফাইন্যান্স অ্যান্ড অ্যাকাউন্টস টিমের জন্য ব্রাঞ্চ হিসাবরক্ষক নিয়োজিত হবেন। Job Responsibilities: সংস্থার আর্থিক ব্যবস্থাপনা নির্দেশিকা অনুসরণ করে হিসাব সংক্রান্ত যাবতীয় দায়িত্ব পালন করা। সংস্থার নীতিমালা অনুযায়ী কার্যক্রম পরিপালন করা এবং সরকারি ও বেসরকারি প্রতিষ্ঠান এবং এমআরএ সংক্রান্ত আর্থিক বিষয়সমূহ আপডেট রাখা। হাজিরা ও মুভমেন্ট ও ছুটি সংক্রান্ত সংক্রান্ত কার্যক্রম সম্পাদন করা ও রেজিস্টার সংরক্ষণ করা। বার্ষিক কর্ম-পরিকল্পনা প্রণয়নে সহযোগিতা করা এবং সে অনুযায়ী বাজেট প্রস্তুত করা। অনুমোদিত বাজেট নিয়ন্ত্রণ ও ত্রৈমাসিক ভিত্তিতে বাজেট ভেরিয়েন্স রিপোর্ট প্রস্তুত করে কর্তৃপক্ষকে অবহিত করা। এলও ভিত্তিক প্রতিদিনের আদায়শিটের টাকা বুঝে নেওয়া, উক্ত টাকা ব্যাংকে জমা নিশ্চিত করা এবং সফটওয়্যারে পোস্টিং দেওয়া। ক্যাশ ও ব্যাংক সংক্রান্ত যাবতীয় দৈনন্দিন কার্যক্রম সম্পাদন করা। বিল ও ভাউচার চেকিং, অনুমোদিত বিলের টাকা প্রদান, ভাউচার প্রস্তুত ও অনুমোদন এবং সমন্বয় সংক্রান্ত কার্যক্রম সম্পাদন করে সফটওয়্যারে পোস্টিং দেওয়া। দৈনিক তথ্যশিট ও প্রাপ্তি-প্রদান শিট প্রিন্ট দিয়ে যথাযথ স্বাক্ষরসহ সংরক্ষণ করা। ক্যাশ বুক, জেনারেল লেজার, আয়-ব্যয় হিসাব, প্রাপ্তি-প্রদান হিসাব, রেওয়ামিল ও উদ্বৃত্তপত্র প্রস্তুত ও সংরক্ষণ করা। সদস্য ভর্তি ফরম ও ঋণ আবেদন ফরম যাচাই ও সংরক্ষণ করা। ঋণ বিতরণের পূর্বে ঋণ আবেদন ফরম সরেজমিনে যাচাই করা। ঋণ বিতরণ ও নগদে সঞ্চয় উত্তোলন/ফেরতের ক্ষেত্রে যাবতীয় ডকুমেন্টস চেক করে টাকা প্রদান করা। কর্মীদের বেতন-ভাতা সংক্রান্ত যাবতীয় কার্যক্রম সম্পাদন অফিস ভাড়ার চুক্তিপত্র নবায়ন কার্যক্রমে বিএমকে সহযোগিতা করা। সরকারি নিয়মানুযায়ি ভ্যাট ও ট্যাক্স সংক্রান্ত যাবতীয় কার্যক্রম সম্পাদন করা এবং সকল রেজিস্টার হালনাগাদ রাখা ও যথাযথভাবে সংরক্ষণ করা। পিএফ, গ্রাচুইটি, লিভ-পে ও স্টাফ ঋণ সংক্রান্ত কার্যক্রম সস্পাদন করা এবং হিসাব সংক্রান্ত রিপোর্ট যাচাই ও পর্যালোচনা করা। মাসিক এফআইএস ও এমআইএস রিপোর্ট মিলকরণ করা এবং যথাযথ স্বাক্ষরসহ সংরক্ষণ করা। মাসিক তহবিল চাহিদা প্রস্তুত করা, তহবিল গ্রহণ, প্রদান ও প্রাপ্তি স্বীকার নিশ্চিত করা। তহবিল সংক্রান্ত বিষয়ে জোনাল অফিস ও প্রয়োজনে অন্য অফিসের সাথে যোগাযোগ রক্ষা করা। নীতিমালা অনুযায়ী ক্রয়-বিক্রয় সম্পর্কিত কার্যক্রম এবং স্টোর ও স্থায়ী সম্পদ সম্পর্কিত কার্যক্রম সম্পাদন করা এবং সম্পদের সংরক্ষণ করা। কর্মীর ছাড়পত্র সম্পর্কিত কার্যক্রম সম্পাদন করা। দৈনন্দিন, সাপ্তাহিক, মাসিক, বার্ষিক আর্থিক প্রতিবেদনসহ কর্তৃপক্ষের চাহদানুযায়ী বিভিন্ন প্রতিবেদন প্রস্তুত করা ও কর্তৃপক্ষকে তা প্রেরণ করা। অভ্যন্তরীণ নিরীক্ষা ও বহিঃনিরীক্ষা কার্যে সহযোগিতা করা। অ্যাকাউন্টস ও ফাইন্যান্স সংক্রান্ত বিভিন্ন মিটিং/ওয়ার্কশপে যোগদান করা। Recommend and coordinate psychological therapies, occupational therapy, rehabilitation and other recovery-oriented interventions where appropriate. The project will priorities operation, maintenance and upgrading of existing water supply, sanitation, bathing, solid waste, and faecal sludge management infrastructure, while ensuring disability-friendly access and WASH Sector compliance. It will strengthen water quality monitoring, community led FRC checks, hygiene promotion, MHM support, WASH NFI distribution and accountability through a harmonized CFM. By promoting 3R-based waste management, MRF operations, tri-composting, local production of MHM kits and soap, and community ownership, SHIFT will enhance local resilience and localization. Objectives of the position:  The MIS, Documentation and Reporting Officer ensures effective management of project information, documentation, reporting and data quality. The role supports timely decision-making, accurate records, evidence-based monitoring, knowledge management and compliance with organizational, donor and project requirements through reliable data systems. Job Description / Responsibility Develop, implement, and maintain the project`s Management Information System (MIS) to support effective project planning, implementation, monitoring, and reporting. Establish and maintain an effective project-level information management system, including databases, electronic filing systems, and data repositories. Develop and maintain beneficiary databases, activity tracking systems, service mapping, contact lists, and other project information management tools. Collect, compile, verify, analyze, and manage project data from field teams, ensuring accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, and confidentiality. Ensure the secure storage, regular backup, and protection of project data to prevent data loss and unauthorized access. Develop and maintain reporting formats, dashboards, data visualization tools, and other MIS products to support evidence-based decision-making. Analyze project performance data and generate management information to monitor progress against project indicators, outputs, outcomes, and targets. Support the implementation and regular updating of the project`s Results-Based Monitoring Framework, MEAL Plan, Annual Operational Plan (AOP), monitoring calendar, and field monitoring plan. Support the design and implementation of monitoring, evaluation, assessments, surveys, data quality assessments (DQAs), and learning activities. Prepare daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, annual, and final project reports, including quantitative and qualitative analyses, in accordance with organizational and donor requirements. Support the preparation and submission of donor reports, information requests, presentations, infographics, and other reporting products. Prepare case studies, success stories, factsheets, lessons learned, and other knowledge management products to document project achievements and best practices. Maintain complete, accurate, and well-organized project documentation, records, meeting minutes, correspondence, and electronic filing systems. Prepare and circulate minutes of coordination meetings, technical meetings, and project review meetings, and follow up on agreed action points. Maintain and regularly update camp-level information, including service mapping, 4W information, stakeholder contact lists, and other information management products. Share project information, reports, and data with the Project Manager, consortium partners, relevant government authorities, WASH Sector partners, and other stakeholders in accordance with approved information-sharing protocols. Coordinate with technical, engineering, programme, and support teams to ensure timely data collection, reporting, and documentation. Support the Community Feedback and Response Mechanism (CFRM) by maintaining feedback records, analyzing trends, and generating reports to improve project performance. Conduct routine data quality checks and recommend corrective actions to improve data accuracy, reliability, and reporting quality. Build the capacity of project staff on MIS, MEAL systems, standardized monitoring tools, data quality standards, reporting requirements, and information management procedures. Support donor monitoring visits, evaluations, audits, assessments, and learning events by providing accurate documentation and information. Ensure compliance with organizational policies, donor requirements, data protection principles, and information management standards. Promote accountability, transparency, learning, and continuous improvement through effective information management and reporting. Ensure the safety, dignity, and well-being of staff, volunteers, contractors, and community members by preventing abuse, neglect, harassment, exploitation, and discrimination. Promote and comply with organizational Safeguarding, Prevention of Sexual Exploitation, Abuse and Harassment (PSEAH), Child Protection, Accountability to Affected Populations (AAP), and Code of Conduct policies. Perform any other duties assigned by the Project Manager.

job_description: Nazrul Smriti Sangsad (NSS) is a non-governmental humanitarian organization that has been working since 2000 for the advancement of poor men, women, children, youth, excluded communities, and persons with disabilities. NSS is a non-profit, non-political, child- and gender-sensitive organization. It upholds the values of diversity and inclusion, ensuring equal respect for people of all religions, castes, and creeds, and actively works to eliminate all forms of discrimination, particularly against ethnic minorities and marginalized groups. The organization also promotes equality and respect across all levels of its team members and beneficiaries. NSS is going to implement a project titled “Protocols and Trigger-based Institutional Systems for Timely Humanitarian Anticipatory Actions PROTISTHAA funded by ECHO and implemented in partnership with Action Against Hunger (ACF). The position is responsible for ensuring timely, quality, and effective delivery of project interventions focused on anticipatory humanitarian actions in climate-vulnerable coastal Barguna, Patuakhali and Bhola districts with a duration from May 2026 to March 2028. The position requires close collaboration with government authorities, local government institutions, humanitarian actors, and community stakeholders to strengthen early warning systems, trigger-based responses, and institutional preparedness. NSS is seeking a competent Project Coordinator (PC) to lead the project team. The Project Coordinator will be responsible for the overall management and daily oversight of project activities, including close monitoring and coordination with the donor’s designated representatives and NSS management. Major Job Responsibilities Planning, implementing and coordinating the overall project activities to ensure the achievement of project goals and objectives. Organize and facilitate training, meetings, workshops, and seminars in accordance with project objectives. Supervise and participate in the direct beneficiaries selection process to ensure transparency and accountability. Forma and mobilize CBOs (Women committee) to create a culture of preparedness at community level through meetings, training and workshops. Organize Early Action Protocol (EAP) dissemination workshop at Upazila, District and Divisional level. Implementation of small-scale forecast based early actions to rollout the NEAP. Carry out local level advocacy initiatives as outlined in the project implementation plan. Provide essential field-level support to consortium partner Action Against Hunger (ACF) and technical partner RIMES for project-related data collection, analysis, and report preparation. Establish and maintain strong working relationships with government agencies, NGOs, and donors to foster collaboration and a learning-oriented implementation process. Strengthen the capacity of project team members to ensure effective and quality implementation of activities. Conduct needs assessments of team members and takes initiatives to address identified capacity gaps in line with the project-planning matrix. Regularly monitor project progress, ensuring at least 70% of working time is spent on field visits, and provide supportive supervision to team members. Ensure effective implementation of anticipatory humanitarian actions, including early warning dissemination and trigger-based response mechanisms in climate-vulnerable coastal areas. Maintain strong coordination and liaison with government authorities, local government institutions (LGIs), humanitarian actors, and other relevant stakeholders at division, district and upazila levels. Facilitate integration of project interventions into local disaster management and development plans. Oversee development and execution of detailed implementation plans, work schedules, and activity tracking systems in coordination with the Action Against Hunger (ACF) project team. Monitor project progress regularly through field visits, data analysis, and team supervision to ensure quality and accountability. Strengthen institutional preparedness and capacity of local stakeholders through training, orientation, and technical support. Ensure effective collaboration with consortium partners (ACF) and maintain alignment with project strategies and standards. Supervise and guide project staff to ensure efficient performance and achievement of targets. Ensure proper documentation of project activities, including reports, case studies, lessons learned, and best practices. Prepare and submit timely and high-quality progress reports, donor reports, and other required documentation. Monitor budget utilization and ensure cost-effective use of resources in compliance with donor and organizational policies. Support implementation of monitoring, evaluation, accountability, and learning (MEAL) systems. Promote community participation, inclusion, gender equality, and safeguarding across all project interventions. Ensure effective functioning of Feedback, Complaints, and Response Mechanism (FCRM). Identify challenges, risks, and bottlenecks in implementation and take proactive measures to address them. Represent the project in coordination meetings, forums, and stakeholder consultations at local and regional levels. Evaluate program effectiveness and ensure expenditures align with approved budget allocations. Provide supportive supervision to field staff and facilitators based on work plans and schedules. Participate in NGO coordination meetings at Upazila and District levels, share project progress, and document and archive meeting minutes. Participate in GO-NGO coordination meetings and Disaster Management Committee meetings at district and upazila levels. Document best practices, case studies, success stories, lessons learned, and life stories from the project. Prepare comprehensive reports on meetings, workshops, seminars, and overall project progress and impact. Develop and submit monthly, quarterly, and annual reports to donors and stakeholders, incorporating feedback for continuous improvement. Conduct budget reviews, variance analysis, review financial documents, petty cash, and transactions and ensure effective utilization of resources in coordination with the finance team. Support the implementation of internal control systems and procurement processes in compliance with organizational policies. Promote and ensure adherence to PSEA (Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse) and safeguarding policies across all project activities. Perform any additional administrative and programmatic tasks as required by the project and support organizational planning and decision-making processes. Assist in content creation for platforms such as LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube, focusing on mental health education, therapist spotlights, and client success stories (anonymized). Help manage and optimize Chum Wellness's presence on business directories, review platforms, and professional networks to strengthen the platform's online visibility and local SEO authority in Dhaka. Prepare weekly reports summarizing market insights, partnership progress, and growth opportunities for the leadership team. Community Engagement: Help organize and coordinate community mental health awareness events, webinars, and panel discussions featuring Chum Wellness psychologists. Support therapist onboarding workflows, client communications, and appointment scheduling processes on the Chum Wellness platform. Real-world business development skills including cold outreach, partnership negotiation, and go-to-market strategy within the clinical psychology and healthcare space. Hands-on experience with digital marketing, SEO strategy, social media management, and content creation for a healthcare brand. Exposure to the founding team's strategic decision-making process, giving you a rare inside look at how a HealthTech startup scales in a developing market. Why Chum Wellness: At Chum Wellness, we believe that mental health is the ultimate competitive advantage. Whether it is a startup founder battling chronic burnout, a couple navigating the complexities of a joint family, or a teenager struggling under the weight of academic pressure, our mission is to provide accessible, stigma-free, world-class clinical psychology services to every person in Bangladesh who needs them. If you are passionate about making a real impact in people's lives while building a career in business development and HealthTech, this is the internship for you.

সকল কর্মীর উপস্থিতি নিশ্চিত করা। দৈনিক কাজের পরিকল্পনা প্রণয়নে শাখা ব্যবস্থাপক/সহকারী পরিচালক/সিনিয়র সহকারী পরিচালককে সহায়তা করা এবং কর্মীদের দিক নির্দেশনা প্রদান করা। দৈনিক নূন্যতম ২টি সমিতি পরিদর্শন করা ও প্রতিটি সমিতির শতভাগ পাশবহি ব্যালেন্সিং করা এবং সে মোতাবেক রেজুলেশন খাতা ও পাশ বইয়ে স্বাক্ষর করা। প্রতিটি কর্মীর দৈনন্দিন কার্যক্রম নিয়মিত মনিটরিং করা এবং শৃঙ্খলা বজায় রেখে টিমওয়ার্কের মাধ্যমে শাখার সকল ধরনের কার্যক্রম বাস্তবায়ন করা। মাসিক/ত্রৈমাসিক/বার্ষিক লক্ষ্যমাত্রার পরিকল্পনা প্রণয়ন করা এবং তা বাস্তবায়নে সক্রিয় ভূমিকা পালন করা। সদস্য, কর্মী ও অফিসসহ সকল পর্যায়ে কার্যক্রম বাস্তবায়নে সৃষ্ট প্রতিবন্ধকতা দূরীকরণে শাখা ব্যবস্থাপক/সহকারী পরিচালক/সিনিয়র সহকারী পরিচালককে অনতিবিলম্বে অবহিত করা এবং সমাধানের কার্যকর ব্যবস্থা গ্রহণে সহায়তা করা। নতুন সদস্য ভর্তি এবং কর্ম এলাকা সম্প্রসারণে কর্মীদের যথাযথ গাইডলাইন দেওয়া এবং অগ্রগতি তদারকিতে শাখা ব্যবস্থাপককে সহযোগিতা করা। প্রস্তাবিত ঋণ বিতরনের ক্ষেত্রে যথাযথভাবে ঋণী সদস্য ও প্রকল্প যাচাই করে ঋণ অনুমোদন অথবা অনুমোদনের জন্য সুপারিশ করা এবং যাচাইয়ের তথ্য যাচাই রেজিষ্টারে অন্তর্ভূক্ত করা। ঋণ বিতরণের সময় উপস্থিত থেকে ঋণ বিতরণ কার্যক্রম সম্পন্ন করতে সহায়তা করা। বিতরনকৃত ঋণের পোষ্ট টেষ্ট করা এবং যাচাই রেজিষ্টারে তা অন্তর্ভূক্ত করা। বকেয়া নিয়ন্ত্রণ করা এবং বকেয়া সদস্য তালিকা অনুযায়ী নিয়মিত ফলোআপ করার মাধ্যমে তা আদায়ের কার্যকর ব্যবস্থা করা। কর্মীদের প্রতিদিনের আদায় তদারকি ও যাচাই করা। শাখার তহবিলের সর্বোচ্চ ব্যবহার নিশ্চিত করা এবং শাখার উৎপাদনশীলতার মান ও লাভজনকতা নিশ্চিত করা। নিয়মিত বিল-ভাউচার, সদস্য ভর্তি ফরম, ঋণ আবেদন ও সদস্যদের প্রোফাইল ইত্যাদি যাচাই করা। হিসাবরক্ষকের কাজ ও ব্যাংকিং কার্যক্রমে সহায়তা করা। . ঋণ বিতরণ ও সঞ্চয় ফেরতের যথার্থতা যাচাই করা। সকল ধরনের ব্যয়সমুহের যথার্থতা যাচাই করা। দুর্বল কর্মীদের দক্ষতা বৃদ্ধিতে শাখা পর্যায়ে নিয়মিত ওরিয়েনটেশন প্রদান করা এবং প্রয়োজনীয় ক্ষেত্রে প্রশিক্ষনণর সুপারিশ করা। সংস্থার ঋণ নীতিমালা, আর্থিক নীতিমালা, মানব সম্পদ নীতিমালাসহ সংস্থার অন্যান্য সকল নীতিমালা অনুসরণ করে কার্যক্রম পরিচালনা করা। . কার্যক্রম বাস্তবায়নে স্বচ্ছতা ও জবাবদিহিতা নিশ্চিত করা এবং কর্মীদের অনৈতিক আচরণ বা দুর্নীতির বিরুদ্ধে উর্দ্ধতন কর্তৃপক্ষকে অবগত করা। শাখা পর্যায়ে অডিট, মনিটরিং বা কোন পরিদর্শক দলকে প্রয়োজনীয় তথ্য দিয়ে সহায়তা করা। বাজেট ও বিজনেস প্ল্যানের আলোকে শাখার অগ্রগতি প্রতিবেদন প্রস্তুত করা। শাখা ব্যবস্থাপকের অনুপস্থিতিতে তাঁর দায়িত্ব পালন করা এবং সংস্থার প্রয়োজনে অন্যান্য কার্যক্রম বাস্তবায়ন করা। যেকোন অনাকাংখিত উদ্ভুত পরিস্থিতি অনতিবিলম্বে প্রধান কার্যালয়ে জানানো। উল্লেখিত দায়িত্ব ও কর্তব্য ছাড়াও সংস্থার স্বার্থে সহকারী শাখা ব্যবস্থাপক যে সময় অন্যান্য কার্যক্রম বাস্তবায়ন করতে বাধ্য থাকবে।

job_description: Introduction: The Ready-Made-Garments (RMG) Sustainability Council (RSC) is an unprecedented initiative to ensure that garments exported from Bangladesh are produced in safe factories. The RSC carries forward the significant accomplishments made on workplace safety in Bangladesh following the Tazreen fire and Rana Plaza collapse incidents. The RSC conducts structural, electrical, fire, and boiler safety inspections of factories, supports and monitors remediation, conducts safety training and operates an independent safety & health complaints mechanism available to workers in covered RMG factories. Overall Job Purpose: The Remediation Programme Officer (RPO) is an execution-level role within the Remediation Programme of the RMG Sustainability Council (RSC), responsible for implementing and coordinating inspection and remediation activities across assigned factories. The role reports to the Team Leader – Remediation Programme (TL-RP) and plays a key role in ensuring effective execution of programme operations in alignment with organizational protocols, regulatory requirements, and stakeholder expectations. The RPO is responsible for managing day-to-day remediation activities at the factory level, including follow-up and review of Corrective Action Plans (CAPs), coordination of inspection-related actions, and support for escalation processes. The role ensures timely updating of programme data in systems such as FFC/Salesforce, accurate documentation, and consistent tracking of remediation progress. The position supports escalation management by monitoring factory compliance, preparing escalation-related documentation, and coordinating meetings and follow-up actions. The RPO also contributes to handling special investigations and technical queries, ensuring timely communication and coordination among factories, brands, unions, and internal teams. The RPO plays an important role in maintaining accurate records and supporting reporting processes, including document submission tracking, data validation, and maintenance of qualitative and quantitative information for assigned factories. The role also supports monitoring and evaluation activities through factory visits, verification processes, and reporting of critical safety and compliance risks. Through effective coordination, documentation, and follow-up, the RPO ensures timely implementation of remediation actions, supports programme consistency, and contributes to the overall effectiveness of the Inspection and Remediation Programme. Duties and Responsibilities: Corrective Action Planning • Follow up with assigned factories to obtain the latest Corrective Action Plans (CAPs). • Review submitted CAP updates, including action plans and supporting evidence, and provide appropriate comments. • Update CAPs in the database (FFC/Salesforce) and ensure publication on the RSC website. • Track follow-ups and related inspection CAPs and ensure timely system updates. • Prepare meeting factsheets, minutes, and follow up on action points for Finance/Remediation/Technical meetings. Managing Escalations • Follow up with factories scheduled for inspections to ensure participation. • Monitor escalation status, analyze Escalation Assessment Forms (EAF), and prepare recommendations. • Coordinate escalation meetings (Stage 1 & 2). • Prepare escalation meeting factsheets, minutes, and track action points. • Identify uncooperative factories and coordinate with the escalation team. Managing Records & Document Submission • Update the Case Management Tool (CMT) for day-to-day operations. • Ensure inspection reports and CAPs are uploaded to FFC/Salesforce and shared with relevant stakeholders. • Ensure timely submission of required documents (DEA/EA, SLD, FADS, SUPS, SFP, PFP, etc.). • Maintain accurate, detailed, and verified qualitative and quantitative data for assigned factories. • Provide interpretation and translation support as required. • Ensure dispatch of recognition/no-colour letters to eligible factories. • Maintain and update records related to closures, relocations, and remediation finance. • Ensure timely follow-up on direct contribution collection from factories. Managing Special Investigations • Track special investigations and maintain records in the database. • Propose critical cases for factory list review meetings for resolution. • Receive and coordinate responses to technical queries from stakeholders (brands, factories, unions). Overall Monitoring & Evaluation Process • Conduct factory visits (e.g., closure verification, occupancy verification) to monitor worker safety. • Report observed critical health and safety risks. • Alert the Team Leader on issues affecting remediation progress. Perform any other duties and responsibilities as assigned by the TL/Management to support organizational objectives.

সঠিকভাবে যাচাই বাছাই করে সদস্যস্থিতি ও ঋণ স্থিতি পূরণ করে ঋণ কার্যক্রম পরিচালনা করা। গঠিত দল ব্রাঞ্চ ভুক্ত অর্থাৎ দলের অনুমোদন প্রাপ্তির পরই এবিএম উক্ত দল থেকে আমানত আদায় শুরু করবেন। ঋণের নীতিমালা পূরণ করা, দৈনিক আদায়যোগ্য ও আদায়কৃত তথ্যবোর্ড পূরণ করাসহ দৈনন্দিন অন্যান্য আনুষাঙ্গিক কাজ সম্পন্ন করা। সঞ্চয় বৃদ্ধির জন্য প্রয়োজনীয় মোটিভেশনাল উদ্যোগ গ্রহণ এবং তৎপরতা চালানো। সদস্যদের পাসবইয়ে নমুনা স্বাক্ষর করাবেন এবং সদস্য দলত্যাগ করলে তার পাসবইয়ে পরিশোধ বা কোনো দেনা পাওনা নাই লিখে সদস্যকে ফেরত দিতে হবে। পলাতক সদস্য ও পুরাতন ঋণের টাকা আদায়ে সচেষ্ট থাকতে হবে। দলের সম্পাদক যদি রেজুলেশন খাতা লিখতে না পারেন তবে এবিএম’কে উক্ত দায়িত্ব পালন করতে হবে। আওতাধীন সকল সদস্যর বাড়ি/বাসা (১০০% সদস্যর) ভর্তি ও ঋণ বিতরণের পূর্বেই ভিজিট করতে হবে। সপ্তাহে ২ দিন (শনিবার ও মঙ্গলবার) বিগত সপ্তাহের পলাতক, চলতি খেলাপি, অসুস্থ্যতা ১০০% যাচাই করে বিএম এর নিকট লিখিত প্রতিবেদন দাখিল করবেন এবং তার কপি মাসভিত্তিক আরএম কে দেবেন। যে সকল ব্রাঞ্চে ক্ষুদ্র ব্যবসা ও এসএমইডি ঋণ আছে উক্ত ঋণের দল পরিচালনা সহ সার্বিক দায়িত্ব পালন করবেন। প্রতিদিন এলওদের আদায় সিট নিয়ে তা কম্পিউটারে পোস্টিং দিবেন। কম্পিউটার থেকে প্রতিদিন (ছুটি বাদে) দৈনিক তথ্য শিট ও প্রাপ্তি-পরিশোধ হিসাব প্রিন্ট করে ব্রাঞ্চ ম্যানেজারের এর নিকট জমা দিবেন। কম্পিউটারের সফটওয়্যারের মাধ্যমে যে সকল রিপোর্ট প্রয়োজন হবে তা প্রিন্ট করবেন এবং ব্রাঞ্চ ম্যানেজারের এর নিকট জমা দিবেন। ব্রাঞ্চ ম্যানেজারের এর অনুপস্থিতিতে ব্রাঞ্চ ম্যানেজারের এর দায়িত্ব পালন করবেন। ব্রাঞ্চে একাধিক কর্মী অনুপস্থিত থাকলে ব্রাঞ্চ ম্যানেজারের এর পরামর্শক্রমে নিজ দলের আদায় শেষে অনুপস্থিত কর্মীর দলে আদায়ে সাহায্য করবেন। সংস্থার স্বার্থে ব্রাঞ্চ ম্যানেজারের অথবা অন্যান্য ঊর্ধ্বতন কর্মকর্তাদের নির্দেশ ক্রমে বিশেষ দায়িত্ব পালন করবেন।

job_description: 1.     Store & Warehouse Operations Supervise daily store operations: receiving, unloading, inspection, storage, issuing, and dispatch.  Ensure proper stacking, binning, labeling, and identification of materials. Optimize warehouse layout for maximum space utilization. Ensure proper handling of heavy furniture items to avoid damage. Review invoices, work orders, consumption reports, or demand forecasts to estimate peak delivery periods and issue work assignments.   2.     Raw Materials & Finished Goods Inventory Management Maintain proper inventory of pipe, sheet, PP, timber, board, veneer, foam, fabric, hardware, fittings, chemicals, and finished furniture. Support production planning through proper stock availability.   4.     Procurement Coordination Coordinate with procurement teams for material requirements and on time delivery. Ensure quality and specification of materials/goods. Track purchase orders and follow up on pending deliveries. Verify received goods against purchase orders and invoices.   5.      Dispatch & Logistics Management Prepare and verify delivery challan, gate pass, invoice, and transport documents. Coordinate with distribution/transport/logistics teams for smooth delivery. Prepare and maintain inventory reports, stock registers, and other store documentation. Verify the quality and quantity of incoming and outgoing materials.   6.      Documentation & ERP Management Maintain all store documents (Goods Received Note, MRN / Issue Slip, SPR, Stock Register, Delivery Challan etc) Ensure real-time data entry in ERP/software. Prepare audit-ready documentation and reports.    7.     Team Management & Leadership Supervise store officers, store keepers, helpers, and loaders. Assign daily tasks and monitor productivity & performance. Provide training on material handling, safety, and SOP. Evaluate team performance and ensure discipline. Provide training on store procedures and safety practices. Monitor workplace performance and lead training initiatives to improve employees   8.     Store Safety & Security Ensure proper storage of flammable items (chemicals, polish, and thinner). Maintain fire safety, PPE usage, and workplace safety standards. Implement proper handling procedures for hazardous or sensitive items. Ensure cleanliness, pest control, and proper ventilation in store areas. Follow company policies, ISO standards, and audit compliance.     9.      Cost Control & Loss Prevention Monitor slow-moving, non-moving, and obsolete inventory.  Reduce damage during handling and storage (especially furniture items). Minimize inventory losses, damages, and obsolescence. Suggest improvements for cost optimization and process efficiency.   10.  Reporting & Analysis Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports (Like: Stock report, Consumption report, Shortage/excess report). Analyze inventory trends and provide recommendations to management. Perform any other duties assigned by management related to store and inventory operations.

job_description: Job Summary: The Sr. Medical Officer / Medical Officer – Infection Control  at Bangladesh Specialized Hospital is responsible for implementing and maintaining an effective Infection Prevention and Control (IPC) program to reduce healthcare-associated infections and ensure patient, staff, and visitor safety. The role involves surveillance of infections, monitoring compliance with IPC policies, conducting audits and outbreak investigations, providing staff training, and ensuring adherence to national and international infection control standards. The Medical Officer works collaboratively with clinical, nursing, laboratory, pharmacy, and support services to promote best practices in hygiene, sterilization, antimicrobial stewardship, and environmental safety while supporting hospital quality improvement and accreditation initiatives. Key Responsibilities Infection Prevention & Control Management Develop, implement, and regularly update infection prevention and control policies, guidelines, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Ensure effective implementation of IPC practices across all clinical and non-clinical areas. Conduct regular infection risk assessments and recommend corrective and preventive actions. Support antimicrobial stewardship initiatives in collaboration with relevant departments. Surveillance & Data Management Conduct continuous surveillance of healthcare-associated infections. Collect, analyze, interpret, and report infection control data to identify trends and potential outbreaks. Investigate suspected or confirmed infection outbreaks and coordinate timely response measures. Maintain accurate IPC records, reports, and documentation. Monitoring, Audit & Compliance Monitor compliance with infection control protocols, including hand hygiene, PPE usage, isolation practices, and waste management. Conduct regular IPC audits and Hospital rounds. Prepare the hospital for internal and external inspections, audits, and accreditation requirements. Ensure adherence to national health regulations and international IPC guidelines. Training & Capacity Building Plan and conduct infection control training programs for doctors, nurses, paramedical staff, and support staff. Provide orientation and refresher training on infection prevention practices. Promote awareness of updated IPC guidelines and emerging infectious disease threats. Collaboration & Coordination Work closely with clinical departments, nursing services, laboratory, pharmacy, housekeeping, and engineering teams. Actively participate in the Infection Prevention & Control Committee and quality improvement initiatives. Provide expert advice on patient isolation and infection control measures. Equipment, Environment & Safety Ensure proper sterilization, disinfection, and handling of medical instruments and equipment. Monitor environmental hygiene, including cleaning, disinfection, and ventilation practices. Advise on hospital infrastructure, workflow, and patient movement to reduce infection risks. Reporting & Communication Prepare and submit regular IPC reports to hospital management and regulatory authorities as required. Communicate infection control issues, risks, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders. Maintain confidentiality and professional standards in all communications.
job_title: Sr. Medical Officer / Medical Officer-Infection Control Dept.

বিদ্যমান চ্যানেল অংশীদারদের সঙ্গে সম্পর্ক জোরদার; ট্রেড সংক্রান্ত সমস্যা, ক্রেডিট বিষয়াদি ও রিপ্লেসমেন্ট দাবিগুলো দ্রুততার সঙ্গে নিষ্পত্তি করা। বাজার গবেষণা ও প্রতিযোগিতা পর্যবেক্ষণ:  প্রতিযোগী ব্র্যান্ড, মূল্যনির্ধারণ, নতুন পণ্য, ট্রেড স্কিম, ভোক্তা প্রবণতা এবং ফুটওয়্যার ফ্যাশন ট্রেন্ড সম্পর্কে নিয়মিত তথ্য সংগ্রহ; সাপ্তাহিক ভিত্তিতে কার্যকর পর্যবেক্ষণ প্রধান কার্যালয়ে প্রতিবেদন আকারে দাখিল। বিক্রয় পূর্বাভাস ও প্রতিবেদন:  নির্ধারিত রিপোর্টিং টুল অ্যাপের মাধ্যমে নির্ভুল দৈনিক রিপোর্ট, সাপ্তাহিক বিক্রয় পূর্বাভাস, মাসিক পারফরম্যান্স রিভিউ এবং প্রতিযোগীদের কার্যক্রমের প্রতিবেদন জমা প্রদান। নতুন পণ্য বাজারজাতকরণ ও রেঞ্জ সেলিং:  নতুন ফুটওয়্যার মডেল এবং মৌসুমি কালেকশন (ফরমাল, ক্যাজুয়াল, স্পোর্টস, স্কুল, বর্ষা, শীত, ঈদ ইত্যাদি)-এর সফল উন্মোচন; খুচরা বিক্রেতাদের পণ্যের বৈশিষ্ট্য, USP ও মূল্যগত সুবিধা সম্পর্কে অবহিতকরণ। গ্রাহক ও ভোক্তা সংযোগ:  মাঠ পর্যায়ে ভোক্তার অভিযোগ, বিক্রয়োত্তর সমস্যা, ওয়ারেন্টি দাবি ও পণ্য সংক্রান্ত মতামতের সমাধান; গুরুতর বিষয়সমূহ প্রস্তাবিত সমাধানসহ ঊর্ধ্বতন কর্তৃপক্ষের নিকট উপস্থাপন। কমপ্লায়েন্স ও শৃঙ্খলা:  মাঠ পর্যায়ে নাসির ফুটওয়্যার-এর প্রতিনিধিত্ব করার সময় কোম্পানির বিক্রয় নীতি, ক্রেডিট নীতি, আচরণবিধি (Code of Conduct) এবং Grooming Standard কঠোরভাবে অনুসরণ।

job_description: Bakhtunnessa Chowdhury Diagnostic Center (one of the subsidiary of East Coast Group), which is a non profit organization for which we are looking for a female  Physiotherapist. We are seeking a qualified and compassionate Physiotherapist to join our Rehabilitation & Physiotherapy Services team. The incumbent will be responsible for assessing, diagnosing and treating patients with physical impairments, disabilities, and movement disorders through evidence-based physiotherapy interventions. The role also includes developing individualized treatment plans, providing rehabilitation services, educating patients and caregivers, and maintaining accurate clinical documentation in line with healthcare standards. Key Responsibilities Conduct comprehensive patient assessments and establish physiotherapy diagnoses. Develop and implement individualized treatment plans based on patient needs and rehabilitation goals. Provide physiotherapy interventions for musculoskeletal, neurological, orthopedic, pediatric, geriatric, sports injury, post-operative and rehabilitation patients. Administer electrotherapy modalities such as Ultrasound Therapy, Electrotherapy, Short Wave Diathermy (SWD), Pulsed Shortwave Therapy, Infrared Radiation (IRR), and other approved treatment techniques. Operate and monitor traction equipment, including Cervical and Lumbar Traction Units, ensuring patient safety and treatment effectiveness. Conduct exercise therapy sessions utilizing rehabilitation equipment such as treadmills, static cycles, gym balls, therabands, sandbags, standing frames, and other therapeutic tools. Educate patients and caregivers regarding home exercise programs, posture correction, mobility improvement, injury prevention, and self-management techniques. Monitor patient progress, document outcomes, and modify treatment plans as necessary to achieve rehabilitation goals. Collaborate with physicians, diabetologists, nurses, and multidisciplinary healthcare professionals to ensure integrated patient care. Maintain physiotherapy equipment and ensure proper utilization, safety, and cleanliness of treatment areas. Maintain accurate and up-to-date patient records, treatment notes, progress reports, and discharge summaries in compliance with institutional policies. Participate in patient case discussions, continuing professional development activities, and departmental quality improvement initiatives. Adhere to professional ethics, infection prevention protocols, and healthcare regulations. Document all clinical encounters, assessments, treatment plans, progress notes, and referrals as per institutional guidelines.

Strategic Feedback Loop:  Translate physical audit findings into actionable, high-level insight reports for company leadership, identifying key organizational improvement areas. job_description: We are seeking a highly competent  Structural Design Engineer  responsible for end-to-end structural design, analysis, review and execution support of building projects. The role requires strong expertise in structural engineering software, manual calculations, code compliance, construction-stage problem solving and coordination across multidisciplinary teams. The candidate must ensure structural safety, design optimization, construct-ability and compliance with international and national standards throughout the project lifecycle. Job Responsibilities: Perform in-house structural design and analysis of building structures in compliance BNBC 2020, ACI, ASCE, ASTM and other relevant international codes. Develop and analyze advanced structural models using ETABS, SAFE, STAAD.Pro and other recognized engineering software. Prepare and verify detailed manual structural design calculations, including dead load, live load, wind load and seismic load, ensuring full compliance with relevant codes and engineering standards. Independently review and validate consultant-issued structural designs to ensure compliance with design standards, safety requirements and project specifications. Identify and implement opportunities for structural optimization and cost efficiency without compromising safety or performance. Review geotechnical investigation reports and collaborate with consultants to determine and finalize appropriate foundation systems. Provide engineering support to resolve structural design issues arising during construction. Deliver technical clarifications and interpret design intent to site execution teams. Monitor ongoing construction activities to ensure strict adherence to approved structural designs, drawings and specifications. Perform real-time engineering decisions for unforeseen site conditions while maintaining code compliance and design intent. Support value engineering decisions during construction without compromising structural integrity.Ensure systematic document control, including revision tracking, accuracy and compliance with project standards. Prepare technical reports based on site inspections, engineering assessments and field observations. Coordinate effectively with advisors, consultants, architects, MEP engineers and construction teams to ensure fully integrated design delivery. Maintain continuous coordination between design, site engineering and project management functions. Ensure structural input is integrated into master planning and architectural concept development. Maintain full accountability for structural safety, stability and code compliance throughout the project lifecycle. Establish internal structural design standards and checklists for consistent compliance across projects. Verify reinforcement detailing, bar bending schedules (BBS) and execution accuracy at site level. Review and certify concrete and reinforcement test reports to ensure compliance with approved design specifications and quality standards. Stay updated with emerging structural engineering codes, materials and best engineering practices. Provide technical training and mentorship to junior engineers to ensure high-quality design interpretation, reinforcement detailing accuracy and adherence to engineering standards. Prepare technical approval documentation for consultant selection, including scope definition, evaluation criteria and professional recommendations for management approval. Review and certify consultant invoices by verifying completed work against contractual scope prior to approval and payment processing. Perform any additional engineering or managerial duties as assigned by senior leadership.

যথাযথভাবে সংগ্রহ/সংরক্ষন করা। গেট পাশ ছাড়া কোন মালামাল গেটের বাইরে যাতে না যায়, সেদিকে লক্ষ্য রাখা এবং প্রতিষ্ঠানের ভিতরে কোন মালামাল প্রবেশের পূর্বে চালান ও অন্যান্য কাগজপত্র ভালভাবে চেক করে প্রবেশের অনুমতি প্রদান করা। স্বাভাবিক দৈনন্দিন কার্যক্রম বহির্ভূত কোন অস্বাভাবিক পরিস্থিতি, দাঙ্গা-হাঙ্গামা, হৈচৈ, দূর্ঘটনা ইত্যাদি বিষয় দৃষ্টি গোচর হলে তাৎক্ষনিকভাবে সিকিউরিটি ইনচার্জকে অবহিত করা। বাহির থেকে  কমি শেফ কিচেন টিমের একটি প্রাথমিক কিন্তু গুরুত্বপূর্ণ পদ, যেখানে কর্মরত ব্যক্তি শেফ দ্য পার্টি, সু শেফ এবং হেড শেফের তত্ত্বাবধানে খাদ্য প্রস্তুত, উপকরণ প্রস্তুতকরণ এবং কিচেনের দৈনন্দিন কার্যক্রম পরিচালনায় সহায়তা করবেন। 
 এই পদের মূল উদ্দেশ্য হলো প্রতিষ্ঠানের নির্ধারিত মান, রেসিপি এবং স্বাস্থ্যবিধি অনুসরণ করে খাদ্য প্রস্তুতির প্রাথমিক ধাপগুলো সম্পন্ন করা, কিচেনের কার্যক্রমকে সুশৃঙ্খল রাখা এবং সিনিয়র শেফদের কাজে সহায়তা করা। 
 
 ২. প্রধান দায়িত্ব ও কর্তব্য 
 ক) খাদ্য প্রস্তুতি সহায়তা 
 
 শেফদের নির্দেশনা অনুযায়ী বিভিন্ন খাদ্য উপকরণ প্রস্তুত করা (কাটা, ধোয়া, পরিমাপ করা ইত্যাদি)। 
 নির্ধারিত রেসিপি অনুযায়ী খাদ্য প্রস্তুতির প্রাথমিক ধাপে সহায়তা করা। 
 খাবারের গুণগত মান বজায় রাখতে সতর্কতা অবলম্বন করা। 
 খাবারের সঠিক উপস্থাপন নিশ্চিত করতে সহায়তা করা। 
 
 খ) কিচেন পরিচালনা ও পরিচ্ছন্নতা 
 
 কিচেনের নির্ধারিত কর্মস্থল পরিষ্কার, স্বাস্থ্যসম্মত ও সুশৃঙ্খল রাখা। 
 রান্নাঘরের যন্ত্রপাতি, সরঞ্জাম ও উপকরণ ব্যবহারের পর পরিষ্কার রাখা। 
 স্বাস্থ্যবিধি ও খাদ্য নিরাপত্তা নীতিমালা মেনে চলা। 
 
 গ) উপকরণ ব্যবস্থাপনা 
 
 খাদ্য উপকরণ সঠিকভাবে সংরক্ষণ ও ব্যবহার নিশ্চিত করা। 
 উপকরণের সতেজতা ও গুণগত মান পরীক্ষা করা। 
 প্রয়োজনীয় উপকরণের ঘাটতি হলে সংশ্লিষ্ট কর্তৃপক্ষকে অবহিত করা। 
 
 ঘ) টিমওয়ার্ক ও সহযোগিতা 
 
 কিচেন টিমের অন্যান্য সদস্যদের সাথে সমন্বয় রেখে কাজ করা। 
 সিনিয়র শেফদের নির্দেশনা অনুসরণ করা এবং তাদের কাজে সহায়তা করা। 
 ব্যস্ত সময়ে দ্রুত ও দক্ষতার সাথে কাজ সম্পন্ন করা। 
 
 
 ৩. প্রয়োজনীয় যোগ্যতা ও দক্ষতা 
 
 কুলিনারি আর্টস বা ফুড প্রোডাকশন বিষয়ে প্রশিক্ষণ থাকলে অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া হবে। 
 রেস্টুরেন্ট, ক্যাফে বা হোটেল কিচেনে  কমপক্ষে ১–২ বছরের অভিজ্ঞতা  থাকলে অগ্রাধিকার। 
 খাদ্য প্রস্তুতি, রান্নার মৌলিক কৌশল এবং কিচেন ব্যবস্থাপনা সম্পর্কে প্রাথমিক ধারণা। 
 স্বাস্থ্যবিধি ও খাদ্য নিরাপত্তা নিয়ম সম্পর্কে সচেতনতা। 
 দলগতভাবে কাজ করার সক্ষমতা এবং দায়িত্বশীল মনোভাব। 
 দ্রুত শেখার আগ্রহ এবং পেশাদারিত্ব বজায় রাখার মানসিকতা। 
 
 
 ৪. কর্মপরিবেশ ও কর্মঘণ্টা 
 
 রান্নাঘরের পরিবেশে দীর্ঘ সময় দাঁড়িয়ে কাজ করার সক্ষমতা থাকতে হবে। 
 প্রয়োজনে শিফট ভিত্তিক কাজ, সপ্তাহান্তে বা বিশেষ দিনে কাজ করতে হতে পারে। 
 
 
 ৫. বেতন ও সুবিধা 
 
 প্রার্থীর যোগ্যতা ও অভিজ্ঞতার ভিত্তিতে প্রতিষ্ঠানের নীতিমালা অনুযায়ী বেতন নির্ধারণ করা হবে। 
 প্রতিষ্ঠানের নিয়ম অনুযায়ী অন্যান্য সুবিধা প্রদান করা হবে।
